system.description: On acquisition and at every rest, choose one wellspring — air, earth, fire, lightning or water. Until your next rest you always treat it as available in every scene on top of whatever the GM named; you may perform Elementalism Rituals manipulating that element; you gain Resistance to its damage type; and you may change your damage to its type. The change-type clause also ignores Resistances, as printed. Note also that a second ritual discipline is contested at one per party: a Dowser taking this claims Elementalism for the table.
